payload.description_html: Allosauroid theropod MNN GAD1−2 from the Lower Cretaceous Elrhaz Formation of Niger. Pelvic girdle in right lateral view; photograph (A) and line drawing with two cross−sections and ventral view of the pubic foot (B). Cross−hatching indicates broken bone; dashed lines indicate estimated edge; grey tone on specimen indicates matrix. This specimen was initially included in the holotype of Kryptops palaios, but several subsequent analyses have confidently regarded it as a belonging to an allosauroid, rather than a ceratosaur, with affinities to either the Carcharodontosauridae or Metriacanthosauridae.
